name: ICC Men's Cricket World Cup Qualifier 2027

entry.full_members: West Indies and Ireland (outside the top 8 + hosts on 30 Sep 2026)
entry.league2_top4: TBC: CWC League 2 2024-26 ends Dec 2026 (members: Canada, Namibia, Nepal, Netherlands, Oman, Scotland, United Arab Emirates, United States of America)
entry.playoff_top4: TBC: CWC Qualifier Play-off, about 1-22 Dec 2026 (League 2 places 5-8 + Challenge League top 2 of each group: Italy, Uganda + 2 TBC)

format: TBC: 10 teams; top 4 go to the World Cup (1st direct, 2nd-4th Super Series). 2023 used two groups of 5 then a Super Six.
assumptions: Owner decision 2026-10-08: until the field is known (Dec 2026), the four World Cup places are drawn by simulating the candidates' chances with Elo.

Simulated field: West Indies, Ireland and all eight CWC League 2 teams (the League 2 bottom four are assumed to come through the Qualifier Play-off; the Challenge League teams have no ODI history to rate).
Simulated format: one round robin of 10 teams at neutral venues, places 1-4 = Q1-Q4 (the real format is TBC; 2023 used two groups of 5 then a Super Six).
